rule.description: Redirect staging HTTP to HTTPS while preserving path and query

applicationSafety: Obtain the explicit combined staging release authorization before any mutation.
Read the existing zone entry-point ruleset first and preserve every unrelated rule.
Add only the hostname-scoped rule above; do not enable Always Use HTTPS or another zone-wide redirect.
Do not add or modify HSTS.
After activation, run the 19-route audit with the qa_redirect=path-query marker and require an exact HTTPS staging Location for every route.
